title: Crown grazing lease terms
finding: Review the executed grazing lease for the specific harvest or silviculture activity.

actions.description: Record the Crown lands file, signed lease and management plan. Check the legal boundary, current term, forest entry and timber rights, consent wording, access, forage and range improvements.

title: Lease restriction or outstanding consent
finding: The recorded lease terms raise an unresolved restriction for the proposed activity.

actions.description: Record the exact clause and the status of any consent, authorization or amendment with the Crown land administrator. Check older lease terms individually.

title: Grazing or hay agreement and approved range plan
finding: Review the governing range plan and dates alongside the forestry activity.

actions.description: Record the RAN file, agreement, approved range use or stewardship plan or documented exception, pasture boundaries, grazing or hay schedule, and range developments.

title: Free-growing stand after harvest
finding: Review the responsible holder’s free-growing obligation and any applicable exemption for the net area to be reforested.

actions.description: Record the timber authority, applicable plan and stocking standard, planting or natural regeneration method, regeneration and free-growing dates, and any transfer, relief or exemption.

title: Permanent grazing opening in the reforestation area
finding: Keeping the proposed footprint open would conflict with the free-growing obligation unless a separate legal basis applies.

actions.description: Before harvest, confirm the proposed opening and stocking standards with the district. Check whether a Range Act agreement authorizes exclusive grazing and whether FPPR §44(3)(d) applies. Verify clearing authority for the same footprint.

title: Exclusive grazing or hay exemption
finding: The entered evidence warrants review of this specific free-growing exemption.

actions.description: Confirm the legal footprint and exclusive use, the restricted purposes of harvest, and that the provision applies to the harvest. Review authority to harvest or carry out planting separately.

title: Restriction in the applicable forest plan
finding: The recorded plan clause restricts the proposed activity or requires a step before it can proceed.

actions.description: Record the approved plan, amendment and clause. Check whether retaining the barrier, changing the footprint or timing, carrying out the required measure, or obtaining a plan amendment resolves the conflict.

title: Natural range barrier impact
finding: The proposed practice triggers review of natural range barrier mitigation.

actions.description: Record evidence that the feature controls livestock movement, the approved operational-plan measure or minister’s authorization, and timing and responsibilities. For a forest stewardship plan, see FPPR §18. Check whether a pre-expiry permit carries the duty forward.

title: Harvest pathway in an agriculture or settlement reserve area
finding: Harvest in the covered area requires review against the order’s limited pathways.

actions.description: Check the Part A government proposal, interagency agreement and operational work plan, or the Part B forest-health basis and all Part C conditions. Record applicable permit exclusions and any documented Part E deviation.

title: Site preparation and artificial regeneration under the forest-health pathway
provision: I, Parts B, C.5 and E
finding: Part C.5 restricts site preparation and artificial regeneration for this Part B forest-health harvest.

actions.description: Review the governing permit, stocking standard and approved plan. Document any applicable Part E departure and reconcile any free-growing duty with the responsible district before scheduling planting.
